heroDescription: Nord consolidated the Gowganda Silver Camp through the acquisition of four historic mining leases, adding approximately 1.94 million tonnes of historical silver tailings to the Company's processing pipeline.
regionalTitle: Anchored by Castle Mine and the Temiskaming Testing Lab
regionalDescription: The Gowganda Silver Tailings sit roughly 100 km west of Nord's Temiskaming Testing Lab in the town of Cobalt and adjacent to the Company's Castle Mine property. The surrounding district hosts Agnico Eagle's Macassa and Upper Beaver projects, Alamos Gold's Young-Davidson mine, and IAMGOLD's Côté Gold — placing Nord's silver assets within a well-serviced, actively mined corridor of northeastern Ontario.
timelineTitle: Four decades of drilling, sampling, and resource work
timelineDescription: The Gowganda silver tailings have been the subject of continuous technical study since 1981, advancing from initial auger sampling through sonic drilling, feasibility study, and an NI 43-101 resource estimate.
timeline1Note:
545 auger + 26 drive pipe holes.
~1.7M tons at 1.45 oz/t Ag, 82% recovery.
timeline2Note:
1,000 TPD process design.
85%+ recovery, IRR to 49.3%.
timeline3Event: Sandy K Mines sonic drill program
timeline3Note:
32 holes in core area.
2.0 oz/t Ag, 40% above deposit mean.
timeline4Note:
Integrated 764 holes.
Indicated 1.94M t at 47.5 g/t = 2.96M oz Ag.
timeline5Note:
860+ holes incl. 103 BMR sonic.
Consolidated land package, silver above US $80.
irrTitle: Historic economics at modelled silver prices vs. silver today
irrDescription: Kilborn Limited's 1987 feasibility study modelled a 1,000 STPD tails re-milling project across a silver-price range of US $6 to US $12 per ounce, returning an internal rate of return of 49.3% at the high end. With spot silver trading well above the top of that historic price deck, the legacy projections frame the upside of revisiting the deposit under modern conditions.
irrDisclaimer: Source: Kilborn Limited, 1,000 STPD Tails Remilling Project Feasibility Study, April 1987 (at US $4.7M capital cost). Historical projections are for informational purposes only. No current economic assessment has been completed.
kilbornReportTitle: Kilborn Limited — 1,000 STPD Tails Remilling Project Feasibility Study
resourceTitle: Indicated resource holds steady across a wide cutoff range
resourceDescription: GeoVector Management Inc.'s 2011 NI 43-101 resource estimate, which integrated 764 historic drill holes, shows the Indicated tonnage and contained silver ounces holding nearly flat from a 5 g/t silver cutoff up to roughly 20 g/t — a signature of a well-distributed, homogeneous tailings deposit.
resourceEstimateTitle: Indicated mineral resource (5 g/t Ag cutoff)
resourceDisclaimer: Source: GeoVector Management Inc., NI 43-101 Technical Report, July 8, 2011 (Table 4), Indicated Mineral Resource category. Historical estimate; not a current mineral resource under NI 43-101 unless reaffirmed by a qualified person.
temexReportTitle: GeoVector / Temex Resources — NI 43-101 Technical Report on the Gowganda Silver Property
leasesTitle: Past producers within a single contiguous land package
leasesDescription: The newly acquired BMR leases consolidate four historic past producers — Miller Lake-O'Brien, Millerett, Capitol, and Bonsall — onto a single contiguous land package adjacent to Nord's existing Castle Mine and Castle East discovery. All deposits are hosted in the same Nipissing diabase-hosted, native-silver vein system that defines the broader Cobalt-Gowganda camp.
tailingsTitle: 1.94 million tonnes of historical silver tailings
tailingsDescription: The Gowganda tailings are accessible for processing at TTL and through the Company's separately acquired 600 tonne-per-day modular gravity plant. Recovery Permit applications are advancing under Ontario's framework.
